name: bnbridge
description: BnBridge, bridge your rates across platforms and years: export, import and carry over Airbnb / Abritel calendar prices

scripts.check: for f in $(find src dev -name "*.js"); do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.zip: mkdir -p dist && rm -f dist/extension.zip && zip -r dist/extension.zip manifest.json _locales src -x '*.DS_Store'
